parts.text: Fix the weapon on her back so it is ONE clear, coherent harpoon gun slung diagonally behind her backpack: a thick metal barrel tube with a large barbed steel harpoon spear loaded in it, harpoon point up above her right shoulder, a coiled rope line attached, and a short rounded wooden shoulder-stock bump at the lower end behind her hip. Remove the hunting-rifle look and any extra stock or duplicate parts sticking out below the backpack. Keep everything else identical: her face, straw bonnet, gold hook hand, bone saw in her fist, red bag, gingham dress and apron, green backdrop, clay style. No text.
